nodes.title: About this template
widgets_values:
# 0 · System Check

Press **Run**. The node lists:

- ComfyUI, frontend and Plenio versions, Python and torch
- GPUs, VRAM and system RAM
- which model files of each template are installed, what is still missing, and the folder each one goes into (with its download link)
- the Plenio assets - the lyrics ASR Qwen3-ASR, its aligner and the Whisper fallback - with the folder Plenio keeps them in and whether they are there
- optional Python packages
- the offline and download policy (`PLENIO_OFFLINE`, `PLENIO_AUTO_DOWNLOAD`)
- the hardware table (what auto takes on each card), with the row for this machine marked

Recommendations are text only. Plenio never changes a setting or a model on its own; you choose the model files in the loader nodes of each template.

Set **detail** to `full` to include the raw facts as JSON, for example for a bug report.

# Models · what goes where

This template needs no model file. Run it: it lists what each template needs, what is installed, what is missing - with the folder and the download link. Here is the whole set at a glance:

## The files
- [yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/2f76ca75e6ee094169de899cc7fc99d6887e2196/checkpoints/yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors) · 4.0 GB · CC BY-NC 4.0  
  YuE2 3B music model (int8)
- [ar_lora_inst_v3abc_comfyui.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Mothersuperior/YuE2-instrumental-cot-full-loras/resolve/947f2f4b28978b2b6c3e316e6a87925c76bf3c4b/ar_lora_inst_v3abc_comfyui.safetensors) · 213 MB · CC BY-NC 4.0  
  YuE2 instrumental adapter (community LoRA)
- [sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/YuE2/resolve/2f76ca75e6ee094169de899cc7fc99d6887e2196/audio_encoders/sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors) · 1.4 GB · CC BY-NC 4.0  
  SheetSage2 transcription (score of the source, Check Vocals)
- [pytorch_model.bin](https://huggingface.co/woongzip1/universr-audio/resolve/1c3294844285af851b6ffa56cbde4e43cd41fc2b/pytorch_model.bin) · 229 MB · CC BY 4.0 (weights); MIT (inference code)  
  UniverSR audio super-resolution (8/12/16/24 kHz -> 48 kHz, vocoder-free flow matching): HQ 2 · Regenerate Highs in every template's Master when HQ mastering is on (on by default in Enhance & Master), and Refine
- [minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/9e364ccd290a401561091fb441ed19cd7de92550/diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors) · 4.9 GB · MiniMax-Music3 Community License  
  MiniMax Music 3 diffusion model (fp16)
- [minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/9e364ccd290a401561091fb441ed19cd7de92550/text_encoders/minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) · 9.2 GB · MiniMax-Music3 Community License  
  MiniMax Music 3 text encoder (pruned, int8)
- [minimax_music3_dav.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3/resolve/9e364ccd290a401561091fb441ed19cd7de92550/vae/minimax_music3_dav.safetensors) · 217 MB · MiniMax-Music3 Community License  
  MiniMax Music 3 audio VAE
- [flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Klein-4B/resolve/5b3abca5c0dc1ecd4eaf3340868d09063fc1c965/split_files/diffusion_models/flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors) · 7.8 GB · Apache-2.0  
  FLUX.2 Klein 4B image model (distilled, cover art)
- [qwen_3_4b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Klein-4B/resolve/5b3abca5c0dc1ecd4eaf3340868d09063fc1c965/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors) · 8.0 GB · Apache-2.0  
  Qwen3 4B text encoder of FLUX.2 Klein
- [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Dev/resolve/9630c1b4b6e690497ae0c19bb6b1b35d4ebedcb7/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors) · 336 MB · Apache-2.0  
  FLUX.2 image VAE

## Optional
- [model_bs_roformer_ep_17_sdr_9.6568.ckpt](https://github.com/ZFTurbo/Music-Source-Separation-Training/releases/download/v1.0.12/model_bs_roformer_ep_17_sdr_9.6568.ckpt) · 527 MB · MIT (trainer); trained on MUSDB18-HQ, whose dataset terms are research-oriented  
  stems (the Master's *stems* switch); when it is there, Export Release also hears the lyrics on the vocal stem - their times get more exact

## Where they go

```
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
    ├── 📂 audio_encoders/
    │   └── sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors
    ├── 📂 audio_separation/ (stems, the vocal stem for the lyrics times)
    │   └── model_bs_roformer_ep_17_sdr_9.6568.ckpt
    ├── 📂 audio_sr/
    │   └── pytorch_model.bin
    ├── 📂 checkpoints/
    │   └── yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
    │   ├── flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors
    │   └── minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors
    ├── 📂 loras/
    │   └── ar_lora_inst_v3abc_comfyui.safetensors
    ├── 📂 text_encoders/
    │   ├── minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
    │   └── qwen_3_4b.safetensors
    ├── 📂 vae/
    │   ├── flux2-vae.safetensors
    │   └── minimax_music3_dav.safetensors
    └── 📂 plenio/asr/ (Plenio fetches these)
        ├── qwen3-asr-1.7b-hf/
        └── qwen3-forcedaligner-0.6b-hf/
```

| Template | Needs |
|---|---|
| 1 · YuE2 · Song | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors`, `flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors`, `qwen_3_4b.safetensors`, `flux2-vae.safetensors` |
| 2 · YuE2 · Cover | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors`, `ar_lora_inst_v3abc_comfyui.safetensors`, `sheetsage2_bf16.safetensors`, `flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors`, `qwen_3_4b.safetensors`, `flux2-vae.safetensors` |
| 3 · MiniMax · Song | `minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors`, `minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, `minimax_music3_dav.safetensors`, `flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors`, `qwen_3_4b.safetensors`, `flux2-vae.safetensors` |
| 4 · Enhance & Master | `pytorch_model.bin` |
| 5 · YuE2 · DAW | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot.safetensors`, `flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors`, `qwen_3_4b.safetensors`, `flux2-vae.safetensors` |

The lyrics ASR (Qwen3-ASR 1.7B, 4.1 GB, and its aligner, 1.8 GB) times the lyrics subtitles and hears a cover's words: Plenio downloads it into `models/plenio/asr` the first time it is needed. Offline (`PLENIO_OFFLINE=1`) it names the files to place.

## The writer

*Gemma 4 12B (auto)* in *Writer model* (the default) uses the Gemma 4 12B GGUF already on this computer (`models/LLM`, LM Studio's models, the Hugging Face cache). Without one, the first song downloads the file for this graphics card into `models/LLM`: [gemma-4-12b-it-Q6_K.gguf](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF/resolve/fc034cfff751157913579611efad8462ac1be606/gemma-4-12b-it-Q6_K.gguf) · 9.8 GB from 16 GB of VRAM, [gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-GGUF/resolve/980b060c40a8539ac159e0501a3e0f66a6365af3/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf) · 6.7 GB below (Apache-2.0). Offline (`PLENIO_OFFLINE=1`) it names the file to place.

*Writer model* also takes any other GGUF in `models/LLM`, a model of a running LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM or Jan, or ComfyUI's lighter text model [gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/gemma-4/resolve/63d0f7c476756b88910170c1df75e2384ea1af31/text_encoders/gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors) · 9.1 GB in `text_encoders/`. Only the one chosen is loaded.

## Your graphics card

| Graphics card | YuE2 | MiniMax Music 3 | Cover Art | Writer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| below 8 GB | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot` (4.0 GB) - runs with offloading: slower | `minimax_music3_dit_int8_convrot` (2.5 GB) + `minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot` (9.2 GB) - too large for this card: very slow | `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8` (4.1 GB) + `qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2` (3.8 GB) - runs with offloading: slower | `gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` (6.7 GB); without llama.cpp: `gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot` |
| 8-12 GB | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot` (4.0 GB) - runs with offloading: slower | `minimax_music3_dit_int8_convrot` (2.5 GB) + `minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot` (9.2 GB) - runs with offloading: slower | `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8` (4.1 GB) + `qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2` (3.8 GB) - runs on the card | `gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` (6.7 GB); without llama.cpp: `gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot` |
| 12-16 GB | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot` (4.0 GB) - runs on the card | `minimax_music3_dit_int8_convrot` (2.5 GB) + `minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot` (9.2 GB) - runs on the card | `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8` (4.1 GB) + `qwen_3_4b_fp4_flux2` (3.8 GB) - runs on the card | `gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` (6.7 GB); without llama.cpp: `gemma4_e4b_it_fp8_scaled` |
| 16-24 GB | `yue2_3b_int8_convrot` (4.0 GB) - runs on the card | `minimax_music3_dit_fp16` (4.9 GB) + `minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot` (9.2 GB) - runs on the card | `flux-2-klein-4b` (7.8 GB) + `qwen_3_4b` (8.0 GB) - runs on the card | `gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` (6.7 GB); without llama.cpp: `gemma4_12b_int8_convrot` |
| 24 GB and more | `yue2_3b_bf16` (7.8 GB) - runs on the card | `minimax_music3_dit_fp16` (4.9 GB) + `minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot` (9.2 GB) - runs on the card | `flux-2-klein-4b` (7.8 GB) + `qwen_3_4b` (8.0 GB) - runs on the card | `gemma-4-12b-it-Q6_K.gguf` (9.8 GB); without llama.cpp: `gemma4_12b_int8_convrot` |

No graphics card: the music models are not practical on the CPU; 0 · System Check and 4 · Enhance & Master run on it.
